verdict.rationale: Drata documents its own policy management: a Policy Center help article, plus API endpoints to create policies, list policy versions and create new versions. That gives first-party evidence of policy authoring and versioning. The rest of the story is unevidenced; the Personnel API and the 'monitor personnel' claim are never tied to policy acceptance. missing for 10: lawyer-grade template library, in-app policy editor, approval workflow, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, any description of Policy Center beyond its title, independent or hands-on corroboration.
